resource_reference.reason: The frozen oracle has no separate resource_reference field; resource/dependency distinctions are represented through supported labels, dependencies, and explicit gaps.

source_action_branch_ownership.reason: The frozen oracle adjudicates exact source anchors and material relationships but has no independent source_owner_id, action_owner_id, or branch_context field for supported atoms.

class_b_diagnostics.note: Class B results, formula/sequence metadata, and non-material magnitude/duration remain diagnostic and do not alter primary capability metrics.

final_disposition.rationale: A material Class A root-cause pattern recurs across multiple independent source facts; the contract requires an owner architecture/scope decision before any new loop.

post_execution_report_analysis.purpose: Group material relationship predictions by the same identity used by the frozen evaluator and add non-scoring Class B metadata counts.
